status: Standalone-only implementation contract; see MONTE_CARLO_HANDOFF.txt and monte_carlo_priors.json. Historical acquisition interface retired at user request.
scope: No acquisition valuation, probability, buyer synergies or terminal deal branch. No no-redosing or efficacy-price-premium case.
inputs: inputs.json canonical; MonteCarlo sampler may vary only monte_carlo_priors.json priors and named access/structural strata. Other inputs fixed.
dependencies: Source probabilities derived from shared primitives; never independently sample all origin rates.
Common60%matureoralchoice fixed; launchshare and convergence time uncertain.
Access packages jointly set conversion, delay and net fractions; report separate package-conditioned results.
No duplicate extra category-willingness or dissatisfaction haircut.
Fixed1.17/1.38IRquantity multiplier applied once, including future draws.
Clinical probabilities applied once; four conditional states enumerated.
Foreign ratios, quantity budgets and retention are priors over transfer uncertainty, not measured causal effects.

clinical_outputs.epistemic_distribution: For each commercial draw, report sum of four state probability times conditional equity/share. Quantiles describe uncertainty in expected value.
clinical_outputs.outcome_distribution: Retain four state prices and their probabilities per draw; weighted CDF across states and draws describes terminal shareholder outcomes under chosen priors. Do not multiply each state price by its probability before calculating outcome quantiles.
clinical_outputs.no_double_count: Do not sample approval, then use the already risk-adjusted expected value as payoff.

execution: MonteCarlo production not yet run. Run preflight and validate first; record hashes, seed, draw count, priors and runtime.
return_metrics: Require verified dated entry-price benchmark. No quote currently in model; no return probability claimed.
uncertainty: Analyst scenario distributions, not empirical confidence intervals. No distribution weighting selected to manufacture short result.
